audit_items.proof_trace: Neither transfer entry point (transferInvestorPosition, transferInvestorPositionWithAuthorization) nor any function in the transfer call chain modifies s_saleStatus.totalCapitalInvested. In the merge branch, investedCapital is moved from the burned position to the surviving position with no net effect on the aggregate; in the direct-transfer branch, only the NFT and position-ID mapping are updated. Grep confirms the only writes to totalCapitalInvested are in invest, refund, withdrawExcessCapital, and claimRefundAfterCancel — all outside the transfer path.
